note: 18 -> 12 -> 4. Set at what the tree read the day the gate learned --roots, then paid down by the six sites that were fork renames nobody followed. The gate is ADR-0058's; SCOPES was hardcoded to odoo/ and addons/, so a call to a method nothing defines was caught in the framework and nowhere else. Paid down: industry_fsm_sale's portal_my_task_quotes called _get_order_searchbar_sortings where sale's portal controller spells it _sale_get_order_searchbar_sortings, so /my/projects/<id>/task/<id>/quotes was a 500 -- and the comment two lines below it hardens sortby against a KeyError 500 on a line that could never be reached; sale_subscription_timesheet called sale.order.line._get_delivered_quantity_by_analytic, renamed _get_qty_delivered_by_analytic; sale_stock_renting and pos_sale_stock_renting called _get_outgoing_incoming_moves, renamed _get_stock_moves_outgoing_incoming in the very file one of the two callers sits in; sale_subscription's test helper called _compute_qty_invoiced, consolidated into mixin.order.line.invoice._compute_invoice_amounts; l10n_mx_xml_polizas' tests called _init_options, renamed _generate_options. The last step is not a fix: eight of the twelve were zeep's WS-Security helpers, reached as wsse.signature.<name> on `from zeep import wsse` in l10n_nl_reports' SBR wizard, and they now sit in EXTERNAL_BY_ROOT['enterprise'] -- scoped, so the same names still count as unresolved in odoo/. What is left is four real ones, each named in the research note and none of them a rename: _check_access_token (not defined in upstream 19.0 either, so an inherited defect -- the fork inlined the equivalent consteq check into hr_contract_salary._check_link_access), _share_ticket_on_forums (a missing implementation, not a rename), _find_value_from_field_path (a stale name AND a swapped receiver) and _l10n_ar_get_certificate_object (defined in no checkout, no near neighbour). Four is a list someone can work; twelve was not.
